summary: Private RV park confirmed live: $50 a night posted (weekend $45 30-amp / $60 50-amp, 2-night weekend minimum), 55 full-hookup sites, phone booking. Gate passes at the line ($45-50 cheapest real night). Google 4.5 (189). Weekly/monthly rates marketed and imagery shows nearly every pad occupied; nightly share unmeasurable (no engine). Not waterfront kept.
flags: GATE FACTS: cheapest real RV night $45 (weekend, 30-amp, 2-night minimum); $50 any night on 30 or 50 amp; high $60 (weekend 50-amp). Posted on the operator's own site, read 2026-11-24 - passes (not over $50). GOOGLE 4.5 from 189 reviews.

LONG-STAY (reported, not a drop on the written tests): the operator markets weekly ($300/$350) and discounted monthly ($650/$700) rates and adds '50 per month for electric' in winter - monthly residents exist. (1) price passes; (2) nightly rate posted on its own site + phone, no application - passes; (3) only a 2-night weekend minimum - passes; (4) no count available: booking is by phone ('Book now' buttons are tel: links) so no occupancy check could be run; the undated Esri frame shows an RV on nearly every one of the ~55 pads, which reads as a largely long-stay park; (5) not a home community. A recent reviewer describes a short stay set up on short notice. Read as a mixed nightly/long-stay park, not clearly mostly seasonal; the note says many sites are let by the week or month. Reviewer judgement for a 10-50% caveat.
